# Instructions

Creating a zipper for a binary tree.

[Zippers][zipper] are a purely functional way of navigating within a data structure and manipulating it.
They essentially contain a data structure and a pointer into that data structure (called the focus).

For example given a rose tree (where each node contains a value and a list of child nodes) a zipper might support these operations:

- `from_tree` (get a zipper out of a rose tree, the focus is on the root node)
- `to_tree` (get the rose tree out of the zipper)
- `value` (get the value of the focus node)
- `prev` (move the focus to the previous child of the same parent,
  returns a new zipper)
- `next` (move the focus to the next child of the same parent, returns a
  new zipper)
- `up` (move the focus to the parent, returns a new zipper)
- `set_value` (set the value of the focus node, returns a new zipper)
- `insert_before` (insert a new subtree before the focus node, it
  becomes the `prev` of the focus node, returns a new zipper)
- `insert_after` (insert a new subtree after the focus node, it becomes
  the `next` of the focus node, returns a new zipper)
- `delete` (removes the focus node and all subtrees, focus moves to the
  `next` node if possible otherwise to the `prev` node if possible,
  otherwise to the parent node, returns a new zipper)

[zipper]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipper_%28data_structure%29

Use the instructions above to complete `zipper.py`. Keep the existing function and class names: tests you cannot see import them. Use only the Python standard library.

{"content":"import unittest

from zipper import Zipper


def node(value, left=None, right=None):
    return {"value": value, "left": left, "right": right}


class ZipperTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tree = node(1, node(2, right=node(4)), node(3))
        self.zipper = Zipper.from_tree(self.tree)

    def test_round_trip_from_any_focus(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.value(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.to_tree(), self.tree)
        focus = self.zipper.left().right()
        self.assertEqual(focus.value(), 4)
        self.assertEqual(focus.to_tree(), self.tree)
        self.assertEqual(focus.up().value(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(focus.up().up().right().value(), 3)

    def test_navigation_boundaries(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.zipper.up())
        self.assertIsNone(self.zipper.left().left())
        self.assertIsNone(self.zipper.right().left())
        self.assertIsNone(self.zipper.right().right())

    def test_set_value_keeps_focus_and_preserves_original(self):
        original = self.zipper.left().right()
        edited = original.set_value(40)
        self.assertEqual(edited.value(), 40)
        self.assertEqual(edited.to_tree(), node(1, node(2, right=node(40)), node(3)))
        self.assertEqual(original.value(), 4)
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.to_tree(), self.tree)
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.set_value(10).value(), 10)

    def test_replace_and_remove_subtrees(self):
        for branch in ("left", "right"):
            with self.subTest(branch=branch):
                focus = self.zipper.left()
                subtree = node(5, node(6), node(7))
                edited = getattr(focus, "set_" + branch)(subtree)
                expected = node(2, right=node(4))
                expected[branch] = subtree
                self.assertEqual(edited.value(), 2)
                self.assertEqual(edited.to_tree(), node(1, expected, node(3)))
                removed = getattr(edited, "set_" + branch)(None)
                expected[branch] = None
                self.assertIsNone(getattr(removed, branch)())
                self.assertEqual(removed.to_tree(), node(1, expected, node(3)))
                self.assertEqual(focus.to_tree(), self.tree)

    def test_edits_survive_moving_up_and_across(self):
        edited = self.zipper.left().right().set_value(40).up().up()
        edited = edited.right().set_left(node(5)).up().set_value(10)
        self.assertEqual(
            edited.to_tree(), node(10, node(2, right=node(40)), node(3, node(5)))
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.to_tree(), self.tree)

    def test_independent_edits_from_same_focus(self):
        focus = self.zipper.left()
        first = focus.set_value(20)
        second = focus.set_value(200)
        self.assertEqual(first.up().left().value(), 20)
        self.assertEqual(second.up().left().value(), 200)
        self.assertEqual(focus.value(), 2)

    def test_external_mutations_do_not_change_zipper(self):
        self.tree["left"]["value"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.left().value(), 2)
        exported = self.zipper.to_tree()
        exported["right"]["value"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(self.zipper.right().value(), 3)
        subtree = node(8)
        edited = self.zipper.set_left(subtree)
        subtree["value"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(edited.left().value(), 8)
        value = [1]
        edited = self.zipper.set_value(value)
        value.append(2)
        edited.value().append(3)
        self.assertEqual(edited.value(), [1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_zipper.py"}
